<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:15">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵈ</cite> top <he>ט׳ של פעור</he> a cast of the idol P’or; (<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:2">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>דפיס</he>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:11">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>יראתה</he>). Y. Sabb. IV, 8ᵇ bot. <he>ט׳ של דדים</he>, v. <cite ref="D00955"><he>דָּפוּס</he></cite>.
Dem. V, 4 (ed. Y. טִיפּוּס). Y. ib. 24ᵈ top נחתום עושה ט׳ אחד if the baker makes only one form of loaves. Ib. (once) טופוס אחד (corr. acc.); a. e.—Pt. טְפוּסִין.
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 5:3">ib.</cite> l. c. <he>נחתום … כמה ט׳</he> if the baker makes several forms of loaves. Ib. <he>שני טפסין</he> (corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:4">Cant. R. to VI, 4</cite> <he>טִיפּוּסִים של פעור</he>, v. supra.
